tree.text: A master may not refuse to permit, deny the opportunity to, or hinder a seaman who wishes to make a complaint authorized by this chapter.
A master violating this section is liable to the United States Government for civil penalty of $500.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource section (U.S. Code) 1090746:65346:664 Section 10907 prohibits a master from hindering a seaman from making a complaint authorized by this chapter and subjects the master to a fine for violation of this section.
